description: P29 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, §5.9, decision 26): Brannock's oath, one of the three powers' for quest.world_main's oaths stage. It starts at stage 4. Meet Marchwarden Edda (50; inside the south gate for a giant that fits the streets, on the giants' green for a bigger one), then win the oath one of three ways, each open as a first oath at stage 4: help - break the toll fort's gate and garrison and clear the Raiders' Hollow, then report to Edda (950: the toll fort 150, the Hollow 150, the oath 650; Brannock allied, its banner - a parley token - and the iron of a free reinforcement at its smithy, the giant's banners on its gates); intimidate - loom over her hall (750; Brannock pays tribute: 2 iron, the tribute heaped at its gate, its smithy serves); force - smash the south gatehouse (50, the town turns hostile) and take the oath by fear (700; the gate stays broken, the smithy shut, until Edda is paid 2 iron). Every resolution pays the oath's reward (loot.oath_reward: 1 titan iron, 2 iron) and lifts the XP to level 9. Worst path 800 XP, best 1,000.

stages.objective: Win Brannock's oath: free the March's roads, cow the town, or take it by force
stages.waiting_text: Edda asks you to break the toll-riders' fort and clear the Raiders' Hollow, then come back to her.
